charts.question: Walk-forward growth remains benchmarked through time
charts.supported_finding: The adaptive allocation uses only trailing information and remains beside equal-weight and 60/40 references.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Historical adjusted-price performance does not establish future returns, suitability, or executable prices.

charts.question: Probability-best preserves correlated market shocks
charts.supported_finding: All strategies receive the same sampled month blocks rather than independent perturbations.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Bootstrap frequency is conditional on this history, block length, strategy set, and estimation design.

charts.question: Risk-adjusted performance is one comparison, not a mandate
charts.supported_finding: Annualized return is read beside volatility, turnover, drawdown, and explicit benchmarks.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The ratio omits investor liabilities, taxes, capacity, and preference-specific utility.

charts.question: Tail loss remains visible across every strategy
charts.supported_finding: Expected shortfall reports the severity beyond the historical 95% loss quantile.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Historical tails are incomplete stress evidence and can understate an unobserved regime.
